title.narrative: Sustainable and Inclusive Dairy Food System Project

description.narrative:
Project Description The Sustainable and Inclusive Dairy Food System (SIDAFS) Project will be implemented by BAMSCOS Cooperative Union in Baringo County and parts of Rongai Sub-County, Nakuru. BAMSCOS, a union of 22 dairy cooperatives with 13,516 active members, aims to strengthen smallholder farmers' participation in the dairy value chain. The project's main purpose is to enhance sustainable, inclusive food systems through improved dairy productivity, value addition, and gender equity. It seeks to address low milk yields, poor market access, and gender gaps by promoting climate-smart practices, modern technologies, and financial inclusion. Expected results include:
Increased quality milk production and incomes for smallholder farmers, especially women and youth. Strengthened cooperative capacity for market-driven solutions. Adoption of gender-transformative approaches (e.g., dual membership). Improved access to profitable markets, credit, and micro-insurance.
Key activities:
Capacity building for cooperatives and farmers. Completion and operationalization of a milk processing plant. Promotion of climate-smart dairy and fodder production. Advocacy and networking with stakeholders. Financial literacy and insurance uptake.
Overall, the project aligns with strategies for inclusive growth, resilience, and gender equality in the dairy sector.
